description: Static comparison of production Hook candidates against the supplied WeChat 8.0.80.34 metadata. Not a runtime installation or effect report.
coverage_findings: Current Finder VM initializers omit the obsolete dataScene: segment and match the 8.0.80.34 method encodings.
Current Finder advertisement router includes commentScene: and matches its full scalar/object signature.

The 11 protobuf dynamic getter candidates have property contracts but no declared IMP in the snapshot. Runtime installation depends on generated methods becoming available; absent methods safely skip.
No remaining class/selector rename was found among production candidates with declared metadata.

Shared JSFunctionDef and generic Web bridge filtering is intentionally gated on all six advertising scopes; per-scope product entry points remain independently registered. This is an implementation scope restriction, not a version mismatch.
NSURL is external to the main image. The expected Foundation signature is not validated against an iOS shared cache by this audit.
limitations: Candidates were expanded from literal production calls and local for-loops; scope enablement and method availability determine runtime installation.
Runtime installer rejects absent classes/methods and nonmatching complete signatures; safe skip does not imply equivalent advertising coverage.
Static declarations and encodings do not prove execution, ad suppression, correctness of field semantics, or stability.
